name: Meeting to tasks
description: Turn meeting notes into a Notion page with action items and decisions, keep a copy in Google Drive, and tell the team.

fields.label: Meeting notes
fields.help: Paste the notes as they are. Names, owners and due dates are picked up automatically.

example.notes:
Attendees: Alex, Sam, Priya.
- Alex will finalise the launch checklist by Friday.
- Sam will draft the customer FAQ and share it with Priya for review.
- Priya will book the demo room for next Tuesday.
Decision: launch date stays on the 14th.
